scoring_justification: The headline quantities cannot be recomputed from raw simulation outputs in a lightweight verifier; compare reported values to paper gold with tolerances. The design CSV is audited structurally.

hidden_assets.purpose: Hidden gold values for deflection angle and reflectivity, and CSV structural constraints.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper abstract and conclusion: deflection angle 17.35°, reflectivity 92.31%. Design constraints from paper text (14 bars, period 0.6–0.9 μm, bar width 0.2–0.7 μm, total width 9.66 μm).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Directly copied from the paper's reported numerical results and design description.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's actual reported numbers and design rules; no synthetic data was invented.

outputs.description: Non-periodic HCG grating parameters (14 bars and total width) designed from RCWA lookup table.
Simulated deflection angle and total reflectivity of the non-periodic HCG reflector from FEM.

output_contract.notes: The design CSV is checked for structural validity (14 bars, parameter ranges, total width). The simulation JSON is compared to paper-reported reference values with tolerances; reflectivity is scored threshold-or-better, deflection angle within absolute tolerance.

steps.description: Verify the CSV contains 14 bars + total-width row, periods in [0.6,0.9] um, bar widths in [0.2,0.7] um, total width 9.66 um +/- 0.5 um.
Deflection angle must match paper-reported 17.35° within ±1.5°.
Reflectivity must reach at least 92.31% (threshold or better); full credit for ≥92.31, partial linear credit down to 80%.
